projects.title: Predicting Quebec Startup Funding Round Size
projects.hook: What predicts how much a Quebec startup raises in a single round?
projects.keyResult: Tuned Random Forest: test RMSE $19.3M on 621 disclosed rounds; growth stage beats public backing as a predictor

thumbnail.alt: Box plot comparing funding round amounts with and without a public investor

projects.title: Causal Inference on Startup Failures
projects.hook: Does raising more money actually make a failing startup last longer?
projects.keyResult: High funding adds about +2.2 years of lifespan (95% CI 1.6–2.8); losing to tech giants shows no detectable effect

thumbnail.alt: Causal graph linking founding era, sector and business model to funding and lifespan
